Purvis (1907, 1909 "Through Uganda to Mount Elgon"), Rev. John Roscoe (1915 "The Northern Bantu"), BFBS (1921), Rev. N. Stam (1929 "The Bahanga"), and Payne, Pacchiarotti & Bosire eds.
